projects.title: Nerd Heaven
projects.hook: Find the fault. Fix the mystery.
projects.description: Build practical IT support skills through 27 lessons, network and cable benches, sharing experiments, and support tickets.
projects.starter: Investigate a network fault in the practice bench.

projects.title: Java for Young Robot Builders
projects.hook: Give a robot a little direction.
projects.description: Learn Java, sensors, motors, automation, geometry, and debugging through nine modules and a visual mission simulator.
projects.starter: Plot a route in the Geometry Bench.

projects.title: Weather Everywhere
projects.description: Explore places and maps, compare seasons, and experiment with ocean temperature, salinity, and faraway weather connections.
projects.starter: Compare Antarctica with another place in the atlas.

projects.title: Secret Squares
projects.hook: Pass a message hidden in plain sight.
projects.description: Make real QR codes, damage and recover them, explore bytes and compression, and try shared-key and public-key encryption.
projects.starter: Make a clue, scan it, then try the Damage Lab.

projects.title: Space Camp / For Christa
projects.hook: A teacher who still touches the future.
projects.description: Explore the Space Camp idea and Steven’s tribute to Christa McAuliffe, shared at its original home.
projects.starter: Visit the original Space Camp and tribute.
